title: Handbook availability and left-hand usability
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly mention missing printed handbooks, some awkward left-hand use while driving, and a few fragments that are too unclear or mixed in subject to classify beyond the excerpt.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on the absence of a printed handbook, charging extra for paper documentation, awkward left-hand app use, and a missing light in the hand compartment.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention a left-hand-drive video, paper handbook charges, left-hand familiarity with controls, and difficulty using something with a steady hand while driving, but the excerpts do not provide enough context for a clearer sentiment assignment.

limitations: This topic mixes at least two subjects: handbook or documentation availability and left-hand or hand-related usability comments.
Several excerpts are too short or context-limited to determine whether they express a clear product sentiment beyond the quoted phrase.
The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all owners or all vehicles.
